description: Shared nutroot-v3 test vectors, worked NUT-10/NUT-28 examples (nuts tests/10-tests.md, tests/28-tests.md). Canonical copy: cashu-ts test/vectors/nutroot-v3.json; nutshell copy: tests/nutroot_v3_vectors.json. If vectors change, update both copies in the same commit set. All signatures are BIP-340 with aux randomness = 32 zero bytes.

receiver_keyed_refund.comment: Alice pays Carol 8 sats, refundable to Alice after time t. Receiver-keyed (P2BK slot 0) internal key, one after leaf.

two_leaf_covenant.comment: Allowance covenant: until vesting the kid (key 3) can only spend into the template outputs (3 sat to key 5, remainder to key 6); after vest_time the after leaf lets the kid spend freely; the parent (key 6) holds the key path. Two leaves, one branch: template_witness reveals leaf 0 with path [leaf_hash_after], the after path is [leaf_hash_template].

nut13_v3.comment: NUT-13 v3 derivation (nuts 13.md, the v3 message): HMAC(seed, message_v3) with message_v3 = "Cashu_KDF_HMAC_SHA256" || u32_be(len(scope_bytes)) || scope_bytes || u64_be(counter) || type || u32_be(attempt) || type_suffix. Every type rejection samples: 0x00 the internal private key k (secret is K = k*G compressed) and 0x02 the NUMS offset u against SECP256K1_N, 0x01 the blinding factor against BLS Fr, 0x03 a self-owned leaf key with suffix u32_be(i), 0x04 a mint quote lock key on its own per-mint quote counter, whose scope_bytes is the mint identity pubkey (mint_identity, the NUT-06 example identity) rather than a keyset id, so quote_locks below do not depend on keyset_id. Types 0x00-0x03 share the proof counter. The framing is V3 only: the V2 message keeps its unframed form. Key derivation (0x00) accepts at attempts 0, 0, 0, 0 and blinding factors (0x01) at attempts 7, 1, 2, 2 for counters 0, 1, 2, 3, exercising the rejection loop. Counter 0 also carries Y = bls_hash_to_curve(raw 33 secret bytes) pinning the binary-secret hashing rule and DST across implementations.

transcript.comment: Transaction transcript (NUT-10). digest = SHA256(TLV stream). Each input signs tagged_hash("Cashu_TransactionInput", digest || SHA256(its own container record)) (BIP-340, aux = 32 zero bytes). Containers (high nibble is the section, 1 inputs, 2 outputs): 11 proof input (fields: 01 amount, 02 keyset id, 03 Y = hash_to_curve(secret) on the keyset curve, 04 C), 12 mint quote input (01 amount issued, 02 quote id utf8, 03 lock key), 21 blinded output (01 amount, 02 keyset id, 03 B_), 22 melt quote output (01 amount, 02 quote id utf8), 23 change quote output (01 amount, absent on the remainder quote, 02 lock key). Container types ascend; request order within a type; amounts minimal big-endian; points and keyset ids raw bytes.

tokens_v4.comment: Cross-implementation V4 token vectors (NUT-10 spend-info shapes). One 8-sat proof per token, mint https://mint.test, unit sat, keyset nut13_v3.keyset_id, C fixed. The `si` CBOR map carries k (bearer scalar), e (ephemeral E), i (internal key K), u (NUMS offset, present iff i is H + u*G), t (serialized leaves). The two encoders legitimately differ on things NUT-00 leaves free: cashu-ts writes the short (8-byte) keyset id and orders the top-level map m,u,t; nutshell writes the full 33-byte id and orders it t,m,u. What must agree is the spend_info: each side decodes BOTH strings to the same fields, and reproduces its own string exactly, so encoder drift shows up here.

empty_tweak.comment: Empty tweak (NUT-10, the internal key): an aggregated key commits to having no script path by tweaking with the key alone. t = tagged_hash("Cashu_NutrootTweak", K) with no merkle root, secret = K + t*G. The key is receiver_keyed_refund.carol_priv, so the internal key is receiver_keyed_refund.carol_pub. keypath_priv is (k + t) mod n, the key that signs a spend.

leaf_forms.comment: The leaf types and tree shapes the worked examples never show. Keys are receiver_keyed_refund's, so everything ties back to it. three_leaf_* exercises NUT-10's odd-count sorted fold: ascending by leaf hash the order is leaf 0, leaf 2, leaf 1, so leaves 0 and 2 pair, leaf 1 is promoted unchanged, and the path for leaf 2 is two siblings. blind_slot1_* is NUT-28's positional slot map: alice_refund_pub blinded at slot 1 under receiver_keyed_refund's ephemeral.

auditable_lock.comment: Canonical auditable lock: NUMS offset u = 7, one threshold leaf n = 1 to test key 3 with disclosure mode 0x01, spent in the pinned transaction.

commit_leaf.comment: NUT-10 commit leaf (type 0x04) beside the auditable lock: same NUMS K (u = 7) and threshold leaf, plus a commit leaf whose hash is SHA256("external data"). Never a spend path; the threshold leaf's merkle path is the commit hash.

nut07_commitments.comment: witness_hash = SHA256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the exact witness string value; Y contributes raw compressed bytes.

transport_strings.comment: Prefix plus base64url of the JSON. The signing package is the auditable lock spent in the pinned swap; the spend receipt is the swap bearer input.

template_lock.comment: Template covenant: NUMS offset u = 7, one template leaf n = 1 to test key 3 whose hash is SHA256 over the output section (the two change quote containers of proof_to_two_changes), spent into exactly those outputs. rejected_outputs is the same transaction with the fixed quote at 4 sat: its output section hashes differently, so the witness is rejected.
